wiki.title: Collette Brown
wiki.extract: Collette Brown is a Native American politician serving as a member of the North Dakota House of Representatives from the 9th district. She is a member of the Democratic-NPL. Brown is a member of the Spirit Lake Tribe. She is the Great Plains Representative for the Indian Gaming Association and for the National Tribal Gaming Commissioners & Regulators.
